description: Register a financed invoice on the blind anti-fraud registry. Stores only a keyed HMAC token and registrar hash, never supplier, debtor, invoice number, or amount. Returns conflict when another lender already registered it.

caseId.description: Optional CaseSchema.id to register a purchase row from Book.

currency.description: ISO currency code, for example USD or EUR.

purchaseId.description: Optional purchase row id on the case.

name: register_financed_invoice
title: Register financed invoice
